title: Field-aware invert of a prior SetDissolve command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip SetDissolve of a left remnant onto the adjacent right remnant at the 1s cut with 6-frame handles restores only that command's dissolve write set when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later unrelated SetMarkers does not conflict: invert removes the dissolve, keeps both remnants' starts and the sequence duration, keeps the followed stay cue and the unmoved hello cue, and keeps the later markers. A later text edit of the followed stay cue, or of the unmoved hello cue, also does not conflict; invert keeps the new text.

A later SetDissolve rewrite of the same pair, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. A later leave-gap MoveClip of a dissolve host is not this slice's official conflict path, because that topology edit stays TRANSITION_RANGE_EDIT_REQUIRES_REMOVAL while the dissolve exists. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Leaf-level rational n/d granularity is unchanged. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP, and does not officialize mid-clip insert paste invert, RemoveDissolve invert, or auto-close of a vacated source gap. Invert also mints a new sequence version when clock-stripped transitions change, because sequence fingerprints already close those children. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered edit semantics including insert-mode PasteClips stay unchanged. A diverging unlink invert remains LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH. An overwrite that would uncover or crop a source cue remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. An overwrite that would overlap a followed cue and a dest remnant remains CAPTION_OVERLAP. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip and is not used on this path.

A real UI path splits at 1s, adds hello and stay cues, selects the left remnant, sets a 6-frame VIDEO dissolve, adds a later marker, inverts the SetDissolve command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Extract is not required. Persist-path checks after archive/fork use caption text and anchors, the later marker label, remnant start times, the duration of the remnant that starts at 1s, sequence duration 3, and an empty transition list, not pre-fork transition ids.

Already-delivered ripple delete, ripple trim, leave-gap trim, leave-gap delete, move, lift/cut, split, extract, unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState / UnlinkAudioVideo / ExtractAudioClip / SplitClip / leave-gap TrimClip / RippleTrimClip / rightmost RippleDeleteClips / leave-gap DeleteClip / leave-gap MoveClip / LiftClips / reject-mode MoveClips / overwrite-mode MoveClips / insert-mode MoveClips / includeLinks=false MoveClips / overwrite-mode PasteClips / insert-mode PasteClips, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND.
